# chalk_unmanaged_cluster_background_persistence (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk unmanaged cluster background persistence deployment by ID. **Does not** surface `autodiscover_key` (Sensitive on the resource).

**Required permissions:** `deploy.read`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Background persistence identifier.

### Read-Only

- `api_server_host` (String)
- `bus_writer_image_bswl` (String)
- `bus_writer_image_go` (String)
- `bus_writer_image_python` (String)
- `bus_writer_image_rust` (String)
- `google_pubsub` (Attributes) Google PubSub bus configuration (populated if the deployment uses PubSub). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_pubsub))
- `kafka` (Attributes) Kafka bus configuration (populated if the deployment uses Kafka). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka))
- `kube_cluster_id` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `offline_store_snowflake_storage_integration_name` (String)
- `offline_store_upload_bucket_name` (String)
- `service_account_name` (String)
- `writers` (Attributes List) Background persistence writers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--writers))
